rule.settlement: a property of DECIDED CONTENT, never of a file existing
rule.freshness: a property of AUTHORITATIVE TIMESTAMPS plus an expected lifecycle
rule.readiness: a property of REQUIRED STAGES completing
rule.availability: a property of SUPPORTED DATA, not of a file being on disk

method: Pattern scan over app/src and app/scripts for presence-derived decisions NEAR a state word. A regex cannot distinguish a cache guard from a public claim, so findings start AMBIGUOUS and are promoted only by hand review. `reviewed: false` means nobody has read it yet — not that it is fine.
